segment.source: <end>
Dey're gittin' jetted!<end>
Git fightin', banga!<end>
<end>
<end>
Be careful whatcha do.<end>
Jus' 'cause yer allowed passage don' mean we like ye.<end>
::Points at his eyes, then at you.::<end>
<end>
Ye ain' welcome 'ere, banga.<end>
Leave or go under.<end>
Nuthin' fer ye 'ere.<end>
Ye lookin' fer Donnie? Merchant?<end>
Yes, yes.<end>
Donnie be drinkin' wit' d' girls, yea. <end>
Ye could join 'em if ye wan', he-he.<end>
Where can I find him?<end>
Dey be at d' chillery, at d' Skid Row. Dat thin' dere. ::He points to a group of shacks to the southwest.::<end>
Thanks.<end>
Jet away, banga.<end>
::Nod and leave.::<end>
'E'll be back later.<end>
Nope. Just walking around.<end>
Ah, good.<end>
'Cuz, ye know, <end>
<end>
'Sup, mate?<end>
Whatcha eyein' me fer, mate?<end>
Ye need healin'? Katya - See 'er.<end>
Seen Katya recently?<end>
Ye don' wanna mess wit' 'im - Razor, mate. Dat one clod dat was hittin' on one of 'is girls los' 'is finger fer it, ha-ha.<end>
If ye gunna die, die jettin'. Razor - respec'.<end>
Ye gotta respect d' Black Sea, or else it's gunna pull ye under, mate. ::Nods.::<end>
<end>
Takin' out d' Eel sonar all by yerself... Jettin' respe', mate.<end>
D' Eels ain' nuthin' now without der lil' sonar. Nuthin'.<end>

Dam' we're jettin', pickin' off Can ships an' all.<end>
Yea! D' Jetter's are raidin' again.<end>
Hate 'em Black Eel clods. Dey crampin' our piracy, mate.<end>
<end>
Ye really went under, mate.<end>
Dam', ye got guts openin' a facility all d' way in Scaler territory.<end>
Seen any ghosts in d' hospital?<end>
Wha's dat about statues comin' to life?<end>
Dem ruins gotta be full o' loot. But no one can bloody open 'em.<end>
So Todd's been livin' down under all by 'imself? By 'd sea!<end>
We got der professor!<end>
D' expedition's finally been sen' under.<end>
Cruzer gave dem Eels Hell's Gut before dey got 'im. Respec'.<end>
Is it true ye beat D' Flinger in a flin' off? Dam'...<end>
Never let yer feet dip in the water when jettin'. Dat's how ye lose 'em. <end>
The bes' thin' 'bout the Black Sea's d' crab meat. Mm-hm. Dat thin' tastes better dan hopper!<end>
So... what're ye slickin' at, mate? Blades, guns, cross's? Or ye d' bangin' type?<end>
Heard o' d' legend o' d' White Shado'? D' only man to 'ave ever broken into Port Ceto?<end>
Talk to Donnie if ye got sumthin' fer barter.<end>
Can't get no proper sleep 'cause o' dem nightmares...<end>
Hey, d' nightmares have stopped.<end>
An' stay away, Aegis Inbastardated. Ha!<end>
